plugins.name: mercadopago
plugins.description: Mercado Pago integration toolkit for Claude Code. One agent routes to four skills: mp-integrate (wizard for Checkout Pro, Checkout API, Bricks, QR Code, Point, Subscriptions, Marketplace, Wallet Connect, Payouts, and SmartApps — plus migration of legacy Instore integrations to the Orders API), mp-webhooks (HMAC-validated receiver scaffold and diagnostics), mp-test-setup (test users, credentials, and test cards), and mp-review (quality and security checks). Scaffolding works offline where possible; live account and documentation operations use the official Mercado Pago MCP server on demand.

skills.name: mp-integrate
skills.description: Wizard that scaffolds a complete Mercado Pago integration from official and bundled sources, using MCP only for selected account actions or documentation gaps. Use whenever the developer wants to add or migrate a Mercado Pago payment flow.
headings: Reference files — read BEFORE generating any code
⚠️ HARD LOCKS — read before doing anything else
LOCK 1 — SDK is never a wizard question
LOCK 4 — Tabs row must reflect only the questions that will actually be asked
LOCK 5 — Checkout CTA is mandatory for Pro and API
LOCK 6 — Checkout Pro local back URLs must never enable `auto_return`
LOCK 7 — Point uses Orders API and supports hardware-free test mode
LOCK 8 — QR uses Orders API with an existing Store and POS
LOCK 11 — Marketplace is OAuth + one supported checkout
LOCK 12 — Wallet Connect requires commercial access and server-only linkage
LOCK 13 — SmartApps requires commercial access, Android, and its private SDK
LOCK 14 — Money Out is Payouts and its contract is country-specific
Step 1 — Parse `$ARGUMENTS` and ask for missing context
skills.description_zh: 依据官方及随附资料搭建完整Mercado Pago支付集成，支持新增和迁移流程，仅在指定账户操作或文档缺口时使用MCP。

skills.name: mp-review
skills.description: Review a Mercado Pago integration with a local cross-cutting security checklist and official MCP quality tools on demand. Use after the integration is in place, or when /mp-review is invoked.
headings: Step 0 — Connect only for the MCP-backed review step
Step 2 — Run the official quality checklist
Step 4.5 — Homologation form (final step before production)
Step 5 — Render the Implementation Report (MANDATORY final step)
skills.description_zh: 集成完成后用本地跨领域安全清单审查Mercado Pago，并按需调用官方MCP质量工具。

skills.name: mp-test-setup
skills.description: Create test users and add funds to them for Mercado Pago testing. Wraps create_test_user and add_money_test_user from the MCP. Clarifies that credentials come in APP_USR- (Orders API, Checkout Pro, Point, QR) and TEST- (Checkout API, Bricks, Payments API) formats — both are valid and actively issued.
headings: Pre-check — confirm readiness before creating test users
The current testing model — read first
Step 0 — Connect only before the selected MCP tool
Step 5 — Hand the credentials to the developer
🔑 Login credentials (to simulate the buyer/seller at checkout)
What this skill does NOT do
skills.description_zh: 通过MCP创建Mercado Pago测试用户并添加测试资金，说明APP_USR与TEST凭据分别对应的接口和支付产品；原说明称两种格式均有效。

skills.name: mp-webhooks
skills.description: Configure and validate Mercado Pago webhooks. Wraps the MCP webhook tools (save_webhook, notifications_history) and provides the HMAC-SHA256 signature validation pattern that every receiver must implement. Use when adding, debugging, or hardening notification handling.
headings: Step 0 — Connect only for an MCP-backed action
What this skill does NOT do
skills.description_zh: 配置和验证Mercado Pago Webhook，使用保存与历史工具，并提供接收端HMAC-SHA256签名验证模式，支持新增、调试和加固通知处理。

commands.name: mp-connect
commands.description: Verify or manually trigger Mercado Pago MCP authentication

commands.name: mp-integrate
commands.description: Scaffold a Mercado Pago integration via the mp-integrate wizard. Supports Checkout Pro, Checkout API, Bricks, QR, Point, Subscriptions, Marketplace, Wallet Connect, Payouts, and SmartApps. Also migrates legacy Instore QR/Point integrations to the Orders API.

commands.name: mp-review
commands.description: Review a Mercado Pago integration with a local security checklist and, when requested, the official quality checklist from MCP.

commands.name: mp-test-cards
commands.description: Returns test card numbers for a given country. No MCP authentication required.
